name: Sheet
description: Radix Dialog repositioned to an edge. Four sides via the side variant. Shares every accessibility behaviour with ui:dialog.
intent: A modal panel anchored to a screen edge, for content that needs more room than a dialog affords.

props.name: side
props.hint: One of the side values declared in sheetVariants.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

variants.name: right
variants.when: The default. Detail panels, filters, settings.

variants.name: bottom
variants.when: Mobile action sheets. The most reachable position on a phone.

notes: Sheet is modal. The page behind it is inert and scroll is locked.
On narrow screens side="right" and side="left" occupy three-quarters of the width by default.
a11y.focusManagement: Identical to ui:dialog — trap on open, return on close.

usage: Filters, settings or detail panels beside the main content
A bottom sheet on touch, via side="bottom"
Longer forms that would make a centred dialog unwieldy
doNotUse: A short confirmation — use ui:dialog or ui:alert-dialog
Content that should persist while the user works elsewhere — a sheet is modal and blocks the page
Primary navigation on desktop — use ui:sidebar
Using a sheet for content that must stay visible while working

agentRules: Choose the side from the content, not from habit: left for nav, bottom for touch actions, right for detail.
Long content needs an inner ui:scroll-area.
Do not nest sheets or place a dialog inside one.

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
